verdict.rationale: Datalab's quickstart invites developers to try it before writing code by uploading a document to Forge, its in-app playground at /app/playground, and see results instantly with no API key required. The changelog shows the playground also previews track-changes extraction from uploaded DOCX, PDF, or image files, so it covers more than basic conversion. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence that structured schema-based extraction can be run in the playground, no explicit drag-and-drop mention, no independent hands-on corroboration.
